intro: Every source you have linked, and what it is sending to Kaiord right now.
noProfile: Create an athlete profile to link a data source.
sourcesHint: Each source carries its own browser bridge and permissions
unsupportedHint: Connecting these needs a server Kaiord does not run.

detail.installed: This extension announced itself when the page loaded. Kaiord cannot re-check it without downloading your whole export, so it may have been removed since.
detail.checking: Asking the extension whether it still has a session.
detail.signedOut: Open the provider's site and sign in; the extension picks the session back up on its own.
detail.needsReauth: The extension's access has to be granted again. Sign in on the provider's site.
detail.notDetected: The browser extension is not running in this browser.
detail.disconnected: You disconnected this source in Kaiord. The extension may still be installed.
detail.manual: Anything you type into Kaiord yourself. Never switched off.
detail.unsupported: Kaiord has no way to connect this account yet.

manage.unknown: Unknown until the extension is running
manage.syncFailed: Sync failed. Try again in a moment.
manage.syncCooldown: Just synced. Try again in a minute.
manage.disconnectMessage: This unlinks the source in Kaiord and switches off every route it feeds. The browser extension stays installed.

routing.title: Where each data type comes from
routing.freshnessHint: Times below are per source — when that source last sent Kaiord anything, not this type alone.
routing.unrankedNote: kept side by side, none ranked first
routing.rankedUnavailableNote: ranked to sources that are switched off — nothing is being read

change.title: Where should Kaiord read {{type}} from?
change.unranked: Right now Kaiord keeps every source's {{type}} and ranks none of them; when it needs a single value it uses whichever arrived last.
change.willRank: Pick a source below and that changes: Kaiord will read {{type}} from the one you pick, and use the others only on days it has nothing. You can go back to keeping every source right here.
change.ranked: Kaiord reads {{type}} from {{name}} first, and falls back to the others on days it has nothing.
change.stalled: Nothing is being read for {{type}} — it is ranked to sources that are switched off. Pick one below, or go back to keeping every source.
